runs.stdout:
usage: ci_triage [-h] [--cookie COOKIE] [--output-root OUTPUT_ROOT]
                 [--spec-name SPEC_NAME] [--arch ARCH]
                 [--git-ssh-command GIT_SSH_COMMAND]
                 build_id

Run one QuickBuild failed build through full-log download, Gerrit source
checkout, gbs_analyzer, and gbs_patch_suggest.

positional arguments:
  build_id              QuickBuild build id, for example 1118282.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cookie COOKIE       Browser-exported QuickBuild cookie JSON. Defaults to
                        /tmp/quickbuild_cookies.json.
  --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
                        Output root. The build report is written below
                        <output-root>/<build_id>/.
  --spec-name SPEC_NAME
                        Failed package spec_name to process when a build has
                        multiple failed packages.
  --arch ARCH           QuickBuild GBS report arch, for example standard-
                        armv7l. Required for automatic failed-package
                        discovery when --spec-name is omitted.
  --git-ssh-command GIT_SSH_COMMAND
                        Optional GIT_SSH_COMMAND for Gerrit fetches; also read
                        from CI_TRIAGE_GIT_SSH_COMMAND.

usage: python -m gbs_analyzer [-h] {analyze} ...

Analyze a Tizen gbs buildlog and write an Evidence Packet.

positional arguments:
  {analyze}
    analyze   analyze a buildlog

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: python -m gbs_build_skill [-h] --conf CONF --arch ARCH [--include-all]
                                 --output-log OUTPUT_LOG [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                                 [--src-dir SRC_DIR]

Run gbs build and stream stdout/stderr into a buildlog.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --conf CONF           Path to gbs.conf
  --arch ARCH           Target architecture, e.g. armv7l
  --include-all         Pass --include-all to gbs build.
  --output-log OUTPUT_LOG
                        Path to write combined gbs stdout/stderr.
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Build timeout in seconds (default: 1800).
  --src-dir SRC_DIR     Source directory to run gbs in. Defaults to current
                        working directory.

usage: gbs_patch_suggest [-h] (--evidence EVIDENCE | --buildlog BUILDLOG)
                         [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--src-root SRC_ROOT]
                         [--no-fix-all]

Prepare LLM-ready patch context from analyzer Evidence Packet JSON.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --evidence EVIDENCE   Path to analyzer evidence_packet.json.
  --buildlog BUILDLOG   Path to buildlog. Runs gbs_analyzer first and consumes
                        its evidence output.
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Output directory for context.md and meta.json.
                        Defaults to ./.gbs_patch_suggest.
  --src-root SRC_ROOT   Optional source root for suffix-based source context
                        search.
  --no-fix-all          Disable default fix-all-by-file context and use legacy
                        cluster/multi/single fallback behavior.

usage: python -m gbs_workflow [-h] --conf CONF --arch ARCH [--include-all]
                              --src-root SRC_ROOT --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                              [--timeout TIMEOUT]

Run gbs, analyze failures, and generate suggestion files.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --conf CONF
  --arch ARCH
  --include-all
  --src-root SRC_ROOT
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --timeout TIMEOUT
